newsitem.title: USA: NGC Corp, Nicor in energy venture.
newsitem.headline: NGC Corp, Nicor in energy venture.

text.p: NGC Corp and Nicor Inc said they have formed a joint venture to offer energy services to industrial, commercial and residential customers in the Midwest.
The venture, to be called NICOR Energy L.L.C., will market natural gas, electricity and related retail services, the companies said.
Based in Naperville, Ill., NICOR Energy will initially market natural gas to industrial and large commercial customers in Illinois.
As the Midwest market gets more choice through the deregulation of energy commodities, the joint venture will expand and offer additional energy products and services, the companies said.
